description: What's new near an area since you last looked: new haves and wants within the radius, counts, and anonymous accepted-deal counts. Use a subscription (subscription_id + subscription_token; the cursor is kept for you) or an ad-hoc location (postal_code or city/region + radius_miles + since). Read the results against what your human owns or needs and raise only what applies.

since.description: ISO time; with a subscription this overrides the stored cursor
